info.name: Vidya API
info.description:
# Vidya API

Production: `https://vidya-api-kohl.vercel.app`
Local: `http://localhost:4000`

## Setup
1. Set collection vars `adminPassword` / `studentPassword` from seed (`packages/db/prisma/seed.ts`) — **do not commit secrets**.
2. Run **Admin Auth → login** (or Student login) — tokens auto-save.
3. Use folders 01–11 (Health → Exams) — same domains as `apps/api/src/modules/*`.
4. After editing YAML, run `npm run postman:export` to refresh `postman/Vidya-API.postman_collection.json`.

## Docs
- Swagger UI: `{{baseUrl}}/docs`
- OpenAPI JSON: `{{baseUrl}}/docs-json`
